title: Install
searchText: Install the supported SDK package with the platform package manager.

title: Configure securely
searchText: Configure credentials in server or platform secure storage without URLs, logs, analytics, browser storage, or application bundles.

title: Make the first request
searchText: Make a typed first request and verify the expected event page or scanner decision output.

title: Troubleshoot
searchText: Diagnose unauthorized credentials, connection failure, version mismatch, type mismatch, and unavailable mobile scanner storage.

title: Verify and continue
searchText: Run the executable fixture, then continue to errors, retries, and the generated API reference.
